occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: During a monitoring inspection at the LCCH an infant, 4 months, was observed sleeping on the floor on a napping mat inside of a boppy with a blanket on top of the boppy. Another infant was observed in one of the bassinet cribs asleep on a bobby with the blanket around the bobby. Another infant in the napping room one asleep in the bassinet on an infant co-sleeper mattress. All of these concerns were brought to the provider's attention and she removed the boppies and placed on their backs in the cribs.
